Record Class MKHudPanelDef

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.hud.MKHudPanelDef
public record MKHudPanelDef(String name, MKHudAnchor anchor, int offsetX, int offsetY, int padding, boolean autoSize, int width, int height, PanelStyle style, List<PanelElement> elements, BooleanSupplier showWhen, boolean hideInScreen, @Nullable MKHudPanelDef.HudRenderCallback onRender, @Nullable HudRegion region) extends Record
Immutable definition of a HUD panel — created at mod init, stored in MenuKit's registry, rendered each frame by the HUD dispatch.

Holds a list of PanelElements — the same element abstraction used in inventory menus and standalone screens. HUD-specific machinery (anchor, screen-open visibility, per-frame dispatch) lives on this def; the elements themselves are context-neutral.

Positioning mode. Exactly one of region or anchor+offsetX+offsetY drives placement: when region != null, the HUD dispatch resolves via RegionMath.resolveHud(HudRegion, int, int, int, int, int) with a stacking prefix from RegionRegistry.axialPrefix(MKHudPanelDef, HudRegion); otherwise it falls back to anchor.resolve(...). Builder validation guarantees at most one is set. See M5 design doc §4.3.

Part of the MenuKit framework internals.

  • Method Details

    • computeSize

      public int[] computeSize()
      Computes the panel's size from its children + padding. Used for auto-sized panels. Size = max(childX + width, childY + height) across all elements, plus padding on both sides.
